attempts.text:
Only Shivapuri shelter is a designated evacuation point. The Likhu market road is flooded and the Likhu to Myagang bridge is gone, so Myagang care home can't be reached. The six injured at Dhunche temple can be reached by the Shivapuri-Dhunche road, but the car holds four, so it needs two round trips.

<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dhunche-temple
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 dhunche-temple shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dhunche-temple
load car1 injured 2
drive car1 dhunche-temple shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 injured 2
defer myagang-care-home elderly 1
</plan>

Driving: 13 + 13 + 13 + 13 = 52 minutes. Penalty: 1 elderly person deferred = 50.

COST: 102
